name: LED-Strip Sign Module
summary: Blank shop-sign box with a recessed warm-white LED perimeter and matching slotted wall bracket.
description: Original graphite sign enclosure with a blank porcelain face, continuous independent SIGN_LedStrip emissive ring and separate two-rail wall-mount bracket with four open slots. No lettering, logos, external assets or product packaging. P2 visual module for the GJH Virtual Mall.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original deterministic Blender Python geometry and shared materials; no external models, images, textures, fonts or brands.

interface.runtime: Select SIGN_LedStrip for scene-owned selective Bloom; its HDR emissive material is shared only by the strip. Bloom post-processing, switching, placement height and wall geometry belong to the consuming mall scene.

accuracy_notes: Dimensions and statistics are measured from the delivered GLB. The floor datum is the bottom centre of the unplaced module; raise the root to the desired sign height. Bracket depth is included in the full bounds. Blank static visual asset; no signage text, installation certification, collision setup or electrical simulation. Assembled-mall Bloom, 17-shop integration, full-scene draw-call budget, physical Android/iOS and WebKit have not been tested.

attribution.credit: Original procedural geometry and three shared materials. No external assets.

rights: Original asset; reuse in the owner's projects is authorized. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.
